title: lithocarpus echinotholus
intro: Lithocarpus echinotholus, commonly known as the Bur Oak Acorn or Lithocarpus, is a deciduous tree species belonging to the Fagaceae family. The plant is rich in nutrients and offers various health benefits, including antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, which can aid in protecting against chronic diseases, such as cancer, cardiovascular disease, and neurodegenerative disorders. The therapeutic actions of Lithocarpus echinotholus include its ability to modulate the immune system, reduce oxidative stress, and exhibit anti-angiogenic and anti-cancer activities, making it a potential agent in the treatment of various diseases. The bioactive constituents of Lithocarpus echinotholus include triterpenoids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
